answer: Make every agent prove itself through Ukraine's Diia app: a digital passport verified live against state registries, issued only after in-person registration at a TsNAP centre with a real biometric passport. Forging a thousand agents means forging a thousand passports at roughly $2,000 each — $2 million before one fake earns a coin. When one forgery is caught, the ripple spreads: the terrace of linked credentials — driver's licence, tax ID, vehicle registration — collapses at once, and the pigment of the fraud stains every sibling identity in the batch.
